Metadata.Title: Bloodborne
Metadata.Name: NEO 1440p (2560x1440)
Metadata.Note: Render and display 2560x1440 in PS4 Pro (NEO) mode. Includes the NEO fixes (display buffers sized/aligned for the ALT layout). Requires NEO Enabler. Kyo's resolution patch without his heap lines, screen-size global 2560x1440, private heap +512 MiB, privateB +0 MiB.
